hypothesis.claim: The frozen MU 15m breakout, EMA, and depth-10 pressure onset may contain a repeatable long-side forward edge after measured fee and latency friction.

friction_contract.entry: first executable BBO at or after signal publication
friction_contract.exit: first executable BBO at or after the fixed horizon

assessment.diagnosis: The eighth long onset lost at 15 minutes but recovered to a positive 60-minute markout. It reduced the 15-minute mean and winner-removal margins without reversing them. The 15-minute and 60-minute independent samples remain positive after removing their two largest winners, while the 240-minute sample still fails that sensitivity. All eight onsets are long, so neither bidirectional nor regime-general edge is established.
assessment.single_highest_value_next_investigation: Keep the exact observer running, but do not rerun lifecycle qualification on every onset. Reassess at the predeclared 20 independent paths or immediately after the first short-side onset; meanwhile the portfolio-wide highest-value investigation remains collecting attributable SP500 and SPCX v51 live lifecycles.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Continue MU as a report-only expansion challenger; do not add MU to the live v51 roster.
proposal_contract.why_now: A new independent long onset tested the early result with a short-horizon loss and longer-horizon recovery, providing useful contrary evidence without invalidating the research lead.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: Eight prospective eligible onsets, 42,898 causal book rows, the frozen development diagnostic, exact current fee evidence, fixed-horizon BBO markouts, overlap filtering, winner-removal sensitivities, and the latest exact lifecycle replay.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: MU has materially higher eligible-signal cadence than current v51 index routes, but the evidence is all-long, sparse, and not yet strategy-lifecycle complete.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Observed only for 15m upward breakouts with EMA9 above EMA21 and positive depth-10 pressure; downward-breakout and short-side behavior remain unobserved.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, parameter retuning, rerunning the lifecycle replay after every onset, waiting without analysis, and continuing SP500/SPCX evidence collection. Immediate live addition and retuning are unsupported; repeated censored lifecycle replays are low-value.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A predeclared larger causal sample can determine whether MU adds meaningful opportunity cadence and diversified growth potential before capital is exposed.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Small all-long sample, clustered signals, winner concentration, unverified archive/live candle and pressure transport parity, missing funding and depth-constrained sizing in markouts, and fixed-horizon diagnostics that do not model the actual strategy exit lifecycle.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: All eight entries resolve against causal BBO rows; all eight 15m and 60m markouts resolve; measured fee and residual-latency friction is applied; one- and two-largest-winner sensitivity is calculated; execution authority remained none.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: At least 20 independent prospective paths with both sides represented, exact archive/live candle and pressure parity, resolved stop/exit lifecycle evidence, depth-sized fills, funding, stress friction, and untouched confirmation.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective paths with both directions represented; positive after-friction expectancy and ex-largest sensitivity; no unresolved source or lifecycle gaps; and a stop/exit replay positive under stress without relying on one or two winners.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative after-friction or winner-removal results in the predeclared window, continued absence of short-side evidence, unresolved source parity, unacceptable depth/latency/funding costs, technical observer gaps, or lifecycle economics dependent on one or two winners.

limitations: Fixed-horizon BBO returns are diagnostic markouts, not realized strategy PnL.
The latest exact lifecycle replay has only one completed winner and six censored paths; the eighth onset occurred after that replay.
The prospective source ledgers remain append-only; immutable artifacts freeze exact point-in-time prefixes.
The 20-path and both-side requirements are investigation thresholds, not profitability guarantees or implicit execution gates.
No v51 strategy, asset, route, sizing, leverage, stop, target, execution, or deployment setting was changed.
